At around 4:00am, a quarantined pallet of pistachios was mistakenly brought to the production line, and one full box of pistachios poured onto the line. The error was identified immediately, and the pallet was removed as soon as it was realized that the product had not yet been released.
As a precaution, three pallets of finished product were placed on hold. Two of the three pallets were produced within the projected timeframe of the affected product and remained on hold. A third pallet was also pulled and placed on hold to ensure that all potentially affected quarantine product was removed from the line.
The 3 affected pallets were isolated pending further evaluation from QA.

During the post-cleaning inspection of the Sollich 2 mixer, a piece of a production smock/apron was found inside the mixer.

Production must not begin until the mixer has been inspected and verified to be free of any foreign material to prevent contamination of the caramel.

Please notify the Quality team once the cleaning has been completed so the equipment can be inspected and released before production resumes. Charity Young Ebrima Dibba Jody Howse Joseph Scott
